title.en: DIRECTING ALL CONCERNED GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS TO ENSURE THE MILLENNIUM COMPLIANCE OF THEIR COMPUTER- BASED SYSTEMS
title.orig: DIRECTING ALL CONCERNED GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS TO ENSURE THE MILLENNIUM COMPLIANCE OF THEIR COMPUTER- BASED SYSTEMS

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
All concerned government institutions to avail of the Y2K
services and solution from the Technology and Livelihood Resource Center
(TLRC) in order to render their computer-based systems millennium
compliant by the Year 2000 and at the most economical cost to the
government.

The Technology and Livelihood Resource Center (TLRC)
to formulate and provide cost-effective Y2K total solutions packages
specifically for government institutions.

The availing government institutions to allocate funds
from their existing resources and/or savings for their respective Y2K total
solutions package.

All concerned government institutions to report to the
Office of the President their status of compliance to the provisions of this
Executive Order on or before 31 October 1998.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4 day of August
Our Lord. Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Eight.
in the year of
JOSEPH EJERCITO ESTRADA
By the President
Ronaldo B. Zamora
